SOM.note: Document says nothing on public procurement.

facts.fact: Guleid Osman writes that the Central Bank of Somalia licenses and supervises financial institutions, has introduced mobile-money regulation, and its website reports fifteen licensed commercial banks and six mobile-money service providers.

Guleid Osman writes that the Central Bank of Somalia has launched the National Payment System, the Somali Payment Switch and the Somali Instant Payment System (SIPS), which the Bank states supports real-time transfers among banks, mobile wallets and points of sale.

SOM.note: Safeguarding of customer funds is argued as a reform need; no conduct rule or complaints body is stated.
Cross-border arrangements are only proposed, none stated in service.
Salaries and remittances received by mobile money are not stated as government payments.

facts.fact: Guleid Osman writes that EVC Plus is Somalia's leading mobile-money platform, used by households to buy food, pay school fees and rent, and send money.
Guleid Osman writes that the Central Bank of Somalia states SIPS supports real-time transfers among banks, mobile wallets and points of sale.
Guleid Osman writes that the Central Bank of Somalia launched the Somali Payment Switch and SIPS, which it states connects banks, mobile wallets and points of sale in real time.

SOM.note: Document says nothing on revenue collection.
